description: Experiments on cold-formed steel lipped channels in compression at elevated temperatures is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Thomas Gernay, Johns Hopkins University (jhu.edu). This project involves a series of experimental investigations aimed at enhancing the understanding of the fire behavior of cold-formed steel (CFS) lipped channel studs under compression. The findings contribute to the development of a performance-based structural fire design framework. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords:  Cold-formed steel,  Elevated temperatures,  Fire,  Lipped Channel,  Column,  Test Data. Published 2025-10-20. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
